resources.name: ABINIT software package
resources.notes: Open-source DFT code based on plane waves and pseudopotentials. The paper used v3.1; any modern version supporting DFPT is suitable.

resources.name: Troullier-Martins pseudopotentials for Mg, Te, O and extended Teter norm-conserving pseudopotential for Pb
resources.notes: Standard pseudopotentials available from the ABINIT pseudopotential library; they are also bundled with many ABINIT distributions.
